title: Gains4All
author: Jacob L.
desc:
Gain size and strength in functional areas
99 reps = AMRAP - Burnout set

ex.note: (Sub for 3 sets controlled Pull-ups)
Triple Drop Set - 3 weights (20-30 pound inc.)
Any cable tricep exercise here, overhead pref.
Control as much as possible on ECC.
Ab variation here - Any works
8 MINIMUM here - Controlled tempo
Double DROP SET - Use Barbell here - I like to do 2 10s on either side then drop one off each set
3 Drop sets - heavy weight, moderate tempo -> lighter weight, controlled tempo
Another 3 Drop sets, same fashion as leg extensions
Straight leg to bent knee drop set, alternate order each session
AMRAP on all, unless variation is used

First set is Warmup - 60% of Max
Next set is 70% of Max for 4
Then 80% of Max for 3 3 times in a row
3 drop sets - 12.5 -> 7.5 pounds or similar schema, cables at slightly above shoulder height
Another 3 drop sets, VERY controlled on the way down — this one will hurt
Very deep stretch and control the weight - serratus and other muscles this hits are important!!
Super controlled all the way
Again VERY controlled
Control the weight on either side - one to the right and one to the left together makes one full rep
Make sure these are ACTIVE hangs and scapula is retracted - AMTAP sets
If you can handle more forearm work / if it is the end of the week before your rest day, do this
